answer_1.quote: CommonGen is a constrained text generation task, with the goal of generating a coherent and plausible sentence s describing an everyday scenario using an unordered concept set c = {c 1 , c 2 . . . , c m }.
answer_1.outputs: coherent and plausible sentences describing everyday scenarios based on given concepts
